Walk-Forward Evolution Across Multi-Regime Windows (2 MNQ / 1 NQ)

Each structural improvement was validated sequentially from v4.0 Baseline → v4.1 → d8aaad8 → v4.2 P1+P3_SL (5278092) across 2-Year, 3-Month, RTH-Only, and Recent Sim datasets.

Anti-Overfit, Execution & Volatility Proof: Live IBKR audit through Nov 20 proved 0/7 winners on >60s delayed limit fills (incl. Fri Nov 20's 255s fill into a V-bounce), while Pre-Market (-$4,950 live) and ATR ≥ 75 panics (2Y PF 0.01) destroyed edge. Deploying P1 (±2.00 pt marketable limit + 1b / 60s / +15 pt runaway cancel) + P3_SL (48 pt SL cap when ATR > 60) improves both Year 1 and Year 2 simultaneously with zero added Max DD.
v4.2 P1+P3_SL Global Optimum (2 Years · 5278092): Beats prior d8aaad8 across the board: Combo E (2 MNQ Scale-Out) reaches +$21,392 (+$213,921 2 NQ eq.), PF 1.37, Sharpe 3.35, DD $3,990; and Combo D (1 NQ) reaches +$110,880, PF 1.37, Sharpe 3.34, DD $17,848 (delivering 65.5% WR / +$767 & 60.0% WR / +$2,593 in Nov 9–20 replay including Friday's crash)!

Component Ablation & Simplification Study

Each filter or exit rule is toggled independently to verify what truly generates edge (load-bearing) vs. noise.

Key Ablation Takeaway: Deleting counter-trend V-Reversal, lagging EMA Crossover, and 3-Bar Momentum left only high-expectancy EMA(9/21) Pullback + 30-Min ORB. Keeping PDH/PDL Resistance Guard, VWAP Z-Score Band, and Prev-Bar High/Low Break is essential. Combining RTH-Only (ATR 22–72) with P1 Execution Guards and P3_SL High-Vol Cap unlocks peak 2-Year performance: +$21,392 (2 MNQ · PF 1.37 · Sh 3.35) and +$110,880 (1 NQ · PF 1.37 · Sh 3.34).

Macro Economic Calendar & High-Volatility Spike Protection

Empirical 2-Year NQ/MNQ 2-minute candle spike risk vs. our 40 / 48 pt max Stop Loss cap, combined with live ForexFactory calendar integration (ff_calendar.json) that blocks entries and tightens stops ahead of USD High-Impact releases.

2-Minute Bar Volatility vs. 40 pt Max SL Cap (360,182 Bars)

Why News Filtering Is Critical: During calm US RTH hours, 2-minute NQ candles average 22.5 pts (90th pct 41.5 pts). At 08:30 ET (CPI/NFP/PPI) and 10:00 ET (ISM/JOLTS), 90th-pct spikes surge to 88.1 pts and 80.2 pts (max 279.0 pts) — more than 2× our 40 pt max stop cap.

Empirical Macro Release Windows & Bot Protection Matrix

Live Guard Active: Both bots sync ff_calendar_thisweek.json every 4 hours, enforce Tier-1 (-10m/+10m) and Tier-2 (-5m/+5m) blackouts, tighten open stops 4 min before High-Impact USD releases (+0.30R → BE, else -0.40R), and post a daily 09:00 AM CET (Prague) ForexFactory briefing table to Discord.
